Metadata.title: Nekonoko's Portfolio
Metadata.description: This is Nekonoko, a frontend developer. This is my portfolio site which tells about myself and shows my skills.

About.bio1: I am a dedicated software engineer with 3 years of professional experience, and a total of 5 years including personal projects.
About.bio2: I specialize in frontend development with TypeScript, React, and Next.js. My goal is to take on architect and tech lead roles — driving teams through technical excellence.
About.bio3: I am actively expanding into infrastructure (AWS, Firebase) and AI-driven development to strengthen my design capabilities beyond the frontend.
